Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human Tyrosyl-DNA phosphodiesterase 1 (CHEMBL1075138). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1075138 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require compound_structures joined as an INNER JOIN. Return columns molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
